identification: Single raw live-edge slab chalked 1107, reddish-brown timber consistent with Tasmanian myrtle. From the photo it stands roughly 2 to 2.3 m long and about 30 to 40 cm wide with a waisted outline, bark inclusions at the edges, a few knots and some end checking. Thickness not visible. Part of a consecutive run of slabs (1106, 1108 and others, lots 445935 to 445940) from one vendor.

viewing_check: Measure length, width and thickness (thickness matters most), check for end splits, shakes and rot or borer in the live edges, and note whether it is dried or green. Check whether the colour and figure are real myrtle (pink-red, fine figure) and whether the slab is flat.
